events.title: Major Demo Update: Leaderboards, Evolutions, New Difficulties and More!
events.summary: Major Demo Update: Leaderboards, Evolutions, New Difficulties and More! Hi everyone! Here are the patch notes for the latest Midnight Horde demo update! This will be the big update before Steam Next Fest, with new abilities, reworked progression and difficulty, a Steam leaderboard, lots of menu improvements, and a lot of general polish. I would really appreciate it if you gave the new version a try, tried your luck on the leaderboard, and gave me your honest feedback before the festival begins!

events.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.4.1.8
events.summary: Hi, it has been a while! I have been busy working on the larger scope of the game, but I’m now paying attention to the demo again! New featuresAdded gunslinger as a playable class, he can slide aroundAdded three sets of difficulties per level, you get more resources the higher difficulty, but you need to unlock them. I have not properly balanced the final difficulty yet and interesting to see how hard it feels.Changed UX and path to start playing the game in the UI to make it faster to get into

events.title: NEW TRAILER!!!
events.summary: Greetings! I’m happy to announce the new trailer where I show a lot of the new environment and bosses that I have made! There is also an updated version of the demo with new polish and an updated class selection menu (no new classes just yet) and a new WIP level selection (still only one level in the demo). I have been working a lot on refactoring the core of Midnight Horde to make it easier to implement more meta progression content and quests. Also! I made a cool new website for Midnight Horde

events.title: New Resource System
events.summary: Hi! So I have been working on a lot of bosses ect, but now I took a pause and reworked the resource system. Which should make a lot more sense now, instead of the skulls you now use stone and wood to buy buildings. And these together with a new gold drops, drops randomly from enemies in the world. It is not super balanced yet, but let me know what you think and if there is something you want in the game. Next up I will look into adding the classes to the game. :) Ps this is testable in the live

events.title: Day 1 for Midnight Horde
events.summary: Hello, This is blog post nr 1 for Midnight Horde and I am happy you have taken the time to check it out. Midnight Horde is the result of me playing a lot of Vampire Survivors, 20 minutes till dawn and Dead Cells. The setting is heavily inspired by Mike Mignola and I did get the idea by reading one of his comics and thought that it should be a game.
